method: Normalized SQL source cells, independent pivot and matched-reporting aggregate; all stored reporter and pair rows compared. No collector module imported.

PAS_CRD_key_overlap.meaning: key alignment only; PAS_CRD and PAS_BRD are different quantities

limitations: The five-country cohort and archive horizon are preserved; historical retrieval in 2026 is not current 2026 traffic.
Primary Eurostat singleton comparisons confirm the listed examples only. Full archive provenance remains explicitly DBnomics rather than a fresh primary bulk export.
PAS_BRD/ST_PAS is realized flight-stage occupancy. PAS_CRD is used only for key overlap, never as the occupancy numerator.
Nonphysical or inconsistent ratios remain flagged, not silently clipped or interpreted as unmet demand.
Aircraft type, airline, fare and within-day schedule are absent; gauge is seats per reported flight, not an identified aircraft type.
Airport identity exclusions are kept separate without a minimum-demand or survival filter.
